summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with cache clearing in the Apps class but lacks additional context and testing.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the get_swappable_settings_name cache is cleared correctly. While the existing tests pass, there should be specific tests added to ensure this functionality.
There is no documentation update to reflect the change in behavior of the clear_cache method regarding the get_swappable_settings_name cache.
